source.scope: Git-visible source/config files, including untracked files and memory/records implementations; excludes env, generated outputs, tests and binary assets. Not a deployment configuration or asset fingerprint.

checks.name: T5 private artifact lifecycle, byte evidence and durable recovery
fresh T5 production webpack build against synthetic isolated database
T5 actual file/continuity HTTP and desktop recovery

boundaries.admission: Stored complete bmrv1 plus actual body projection, owner/grant policy, current DB Work binding and durable context audit before a model tool returns content.
boundaries.dispatch: Shared run registry preserves the oldest transcript version; revision, status transition, expiry, revocation, binding change and audit failure fail closed on each Pi logical request.

boundaries.admission: Stored obsrv1. Work evidence independently authorizes its stored canonical parent and provenance target, including accessible history. Owner platform projections match actual physical published fields.
boundaries.dispatch: Rechecks the same observation and all bound canonical versions and permissions; no reinterpretation or replacement of an old body.

boundaries.admission: Real owner/Work-scoped SQL reader plus complete stored ssrv1, original type/time limits and current saved Work binding.
boundaries.dispatch: Rechecks the same snapshot row and full version. A historical snapshot does not establish current business state.

boundaries.admission: Owner-only getMemoryArtifact accepts exact UUID or managed /api/files/UUID, validates complete actual object bytes outside DB transactions, and requires a persisted evidence read receipt.
boundaries.dispatch: Same owner, active full manifest token, evidence receipt identity/purpose/hash/range are rechecked transactionally. Audit says manifest_revalidated and objectBodyReread:false.
boundaries.workAccess: 403 until a formal Work file binding exists; memory grants do not authorize files.

boundaries.admission: Saved checkpoint, immutable runtime origin/configuration, Work/Loop scope, predecessor state and time are checked. Explicit canonical identities undergo real current verification and dispatch registration.
boundaries.unknownSources: Facts, hypotheses, next action and source refs are removed; only genuine historical questions remain. No raw transcript, bare historical summary or business JSON replay.

boundaries.admission: Authenticated owner GET with strict IDs/keys; foreign Work/Loop hidden, Work capability denied. Fixed bounded runtime-authority scalar receipt projection only.
boundaries.semantics: saved, prepared-for-request and usage-observed are distinct; no save/load is unobserved, never healthy. Reading does not write a new receipt or repair state.

boundaries.admission: Ordinary owner/UI reads do not create model scopes. Strict continuity verification requires a live scope. Explicitly unsupported runtimes cannot return newly registered source bodies.
boundaries.limits: One combined limit of 64 exact/context policies and 256 proof refs; shared model read budget remains 10 attempts, 24000 UTF-16 characters per response, 64000 total.

limits: Admission happens before each logical provider request. It cannot revoke bytes already in flight or prove the model understood or acted on a particular source.
Artifact dispatch rechecks the private immutable manifest and original evidence receipt; it does not reread object bytes inside the DB transaction.

Artifact model content supports UTF-8 text/JSON only. Unsupported binary parsing, legacy workspace/RAG paths without artifact IDs and unrelated domain/raw event sources have no implied exact-use proof.
Registered source versions/edges do not prove all transitive derivations are current or all historical data has been migrated.
An omitted memoryTypes grant is currently stored/read as an empty filter and safely denies all types. PG fixtures use explicit types; changing this legacy UX semantic is not part of T5.
External model calls were not used. HTTP/browser and production build evidence belong to the root acceptance reports, outside this summary.

state.loaded: isolated development and fresh production HTTP/browser runtimes

limits: private_local only; explicit nonpublic storage directory required; private_blob/native unsupported
Legacy public cloud objects are not migrated or instantly revocable; uncontrolled legacy import/download returns 410
Existing quota policy remains 204800 bytes, including new unsaved private attachments
Retired object keys retain zero-byte fences; all synthetic body bytes removed through lifecycle cleanup
Artifact model outbounds revalidate manifest and evidence receipt, not physical bytes on every provider request
Unregistered legacy RAG, raw business events, historical chat and local workspace files are outside full outbound coverage
Unknown continuity source assertions are cleared; questions can survive, without independent business validation
Positive-grant schema unchanged; omitted memoryTypes empty-array behavior remains fail-closed compatibility limitation
Synthetic SDK-shaped usage fixture tests projection only; no real model/provider or business Work invoked
Session login, daily instance, cloud/private data and mobile/native specialty behavior not validated
